esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; TFmini-S LiDAR distance sensor needs at least 4.9 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TXD → RX2 (the board's RX), RXD → TX2 (the board's TX). Added the tfmini_s.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the distance, signal strength and chip temperature set on the sliders: passes

pico.detail: 4 pins wired; TFmini-S LiDAR distance sensor needs at least 4.9 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TXD → GP1 (the board's RX), RXD → GP0 (the board's TX). Added the tfmini_s.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the distance, signal strength and chip temperature set on the sliders: passes
